sections.title: Dashboard LiveView
sections.description: Main LiveView rendering the HomeAutomatonKit dashboard UI.
sections.content: This LiveView manages the interactive dashboard interface. It renders widgets, charts, and plugin components. It subscribes to updates from plugins and updates the UI in real-time.
sections.code:
defmodule DashboardWeb.DashboardLive do
  use DashboardWeb, :live_view

  def mount(_params, _session, socket) do
    {:ok, assign(socket, :widgets, [])}
  end
end
